page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s2 family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a direct physical-to-virtual core mapping. The instance is equipped with 4.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include any bundled local storage or GPU hardware. Furthermore, the CPU configuration lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography flags such as AES. These omissions represent a clear tradeoff, limiting the instance's suitability for vector-heavy computations, machine learning inference, or intensive cryptographic processing.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a modest 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as an entry-level dedicated resource. It is designed for workloads that require predictable CPU performance without the overhead of shared-core resource contention, but do not demand large memory footprints or high-speed local storage. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, small-scale development or testing environments, and simple background task processing.
